ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, quadrilaterals $ABCD$, $CDEF$, and $EFGH$ are all squares. What is the sum of $\angle ACB+\angle AFB+\angle AGB$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let the side length of the square be $a$, \\
$AC=\sqrt{a^2+a^2}=\sqrt{2}a$, \\
$\because \frac{CA}{CF}=\frac{\sqrt{2}a}{a}=\sqrt{2}$, $\frac{CG}{AC}=\frac{2a}{\sqrt{2}a}=\sqrt{2}$, \\
$\therefore \frac{AC}{CF}=\frac{CG}{AC}$, \\
$\because \angle ACF=\angle ACF$, \\
$\therefore \triangle ACF\sim \triangle GCA$; \\
$\therefore \angle AGB=\angle CAF$, \\
$\because \angle AGB+\angle AFB=\angle CAF+\angle AFB=\angle ACB=45^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle ACB + \angle AFB + \angle AGB = 45^\circ + 45^\circ = \boxed{90^\circ}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there are three congruent squares placed horizontally side by side, from left to right respectively ABCD, CDEF, EFGH. A, D, E, H are on the same upper side line, B, C, F, G are on the same lower side line, and from A are connected respectively to C, F, G. Reasoning: According to the specified coordinate method, let the side length of each square be 1, take B=(0,0), A=(0,1), C=(1,0), F=(2,0), G=(3,0). At point C, CB is a horizontal ray to the left, CA rises 1 relative to the horizontal to the left, horizontally 1, so ∠ACB=45°. At point F, FB is a horizontal ray to the left, FA rises 1 relative to the horizontal to the left, horizontally 2, so ∠AFB=arctan(1/2). At point G, GB is a horizontal ray to the left, GA rises 1 relative to the horizontal to the left, horizontally 3, so ∠AGB=arctan(1/3). By the tangent addition formula, tan(arctan(1/2)+arctan(1/3))=(1/2+1/3)/(1-(1/2)(1/3))=(5/6)/(5/6)=1, therefore arctan(1/2)+arctan(1/3)=45°. So ∠ACB+∠AFB+∠AGB=45°+45°=90°.

method.method_draft: Use a geometric angle transfer by similarity. From the figure, the three equal squares are adjacent, so C,F,G are collinear on the bottom and A,D,E,H are collinear on the top. Let each side be a. Then AC is the diagonal of the first square, so AC=√2a; CF=a; and CG=2a. In triangles ACF and GCA, the included angle at C is the same straight-line/square angle configuration, and AC/CF=CG/AC=√2. Hence triangle ACF is similar to triangle GCA by SAS similarity. Therefore the angle at G, namely ∠AGC, equals ∠CAF; since B,C,F,G are collinear, ∠AGB=∠AGC. Also, because the top and bottom sides of the squares are parallel, ∠AFB equals the angle that AF makes with the top horizontal through A. Thus ∠CAF+∠AFB equals the angle between AC and the horizontal side of the first square, which is 45°, the same as ∠ACB. Since ∠ACB=45°, the whole sum is 45°+45°=90°.

再推理：设每个正方形边长为 a。则第一块正方形的对角线 AC = √2 a，而 CF = a，CG = 2a，所以 AC/CF = CG/AC = √2。又因为 C、F、G 在同一直线上，∠ACF 与 ∠GCA 是同一个夹角，因此 △ACF ∼ △GCA（SAS）。由相似得对应角相等，故 ∠AGC = ∠CAF；又因为 B、C、F、G 共线，所以 ∠AGB = ∠AGC，从而 ∠AGB = ∠CAF。

接着看 ∠CAF + ∠AFB：由于上边和下边都是水平平行线，∠AFB 可以平移到 A 点看成 AF 与上边平行线的夹角，因此 ∠CAF + ∠AFB 就是 AC 与水平线的夹角，也就是第一块正方形对角线与边的夹角，等于 45°，即 ∠ACB = 45°。

所以所求为 ∠ACB + ∠AFB + ∠AGB = 45° + 45° = 90°。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, quadrilaterals $ABCD$, $CDEF$, and $EFGH$ are all squares. What is the sum of $\angle ACB+\angle AFB+\angle AGB$ in degrees?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Let the side length of the square be $a$, \\
$AC=\sqrt{a^2+a^2}=\sqrt{2}a$, \\
$\because \frac{CA}{CF}=\frac{\sqrt{2}a}{a}=\sqrt{2}$, $\frac{CG}{AC}=\frac{2a}{\sqrt{2}a}=\sqrt{2}$, \\
$\therefore \frac{AC}{CF}=\frac{CG}{AC}$, \\
$\because \angle ACF=\angle ACF$, \\
$\therefore \triangle ACF\sim \triangle GCA$; \\
$\therefore \angle AGB=\angle CAF$, \\
$\because \angle AGB+\angle AFB=\angle CAF+\angle AFB=\angle ACB=45^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle ACB + \angle AFB + \angle AGB = 45^\circ + 45^\circ = \boxed{90^\circ}$

At point G, GB is a horizontal ray to the left, GA rises 1 relative to the horizontal to the left, horizontally 3, so ∠AGB=arctan(1/3). By the tangent addition formula, tan(arctan(1/2)+arctan(1/3))=(1/2+1/3)/(1-(1/2)(1/3))=(5/6)/(5/6)=1, therefore arctan(1/2)+arctan(1/3)=45°. So ∠ACB+∠AFB+∠AGB=45°+45°=90°.
